cases.name: outcome_free_target_has_no_universal_task_utility
cases.conclusion: A frozen input-only target cannot certify utility for all possible outcome laws. A supervised encoder or common bypass may still predict; this is not a whole-network impossibility.

cases.name: perfect_nuisance_target_consumes_capacity
cases.conclusion: Cap 1 nat cannot perfectly preserve both independent bits; no empirical guarantee that soft training hinge achieves the cap.

cases.name: common_target_forces_copy
cases.conclusion: A content head that sees V only and perfectly recovers G forces common information into V. Prior normalization and per-slot budget do not automatically remove it.

scope: exact constructions and entropy identities; no estimated patient MI
